title: Retraction of: Vitrigel-Eye Irritancy Test Method Using HCE-T Cells
content: This is a retraction of Hiroyuki Yamaguchi, Hajime Kojima, Toshiaki Takezawa, Vitrigel-Eye Irritancy Test Method Using HCE-T Cells, Toxicological Sciences, Volume 135, Issue 2, October 2013, Pages 347–355, https://doi.org/10.1093/toxsci/kft159.
